method: Compare eight deliberately varied existing source classes. Record each item's declared valid inference target and exclusions rather than granting a global high-to-low authority score. Preserve original metadata exactly and distinguish first-party platform rules from independent population estimation.
population: Eight selected public source records, out of the existing YouTube evidence register; neither an all-sources quality certification nor a review of full texts or raw datasets

source_records.valid_for: Documented YouTube program-eligibility requirements at a retrieval date
source_records.not_for: Actual approval of a specific channel, creator wages or long-term unchanged terms

source_records.valid_for: Published U.S.-adult within-subgroup self-reported YouTube ever-use, survey dates, whole-sample n and method
source_records.not_for: Country-global people counts, creator earnings, subgroup cross-tabs or single-cell standard errors

source_records.valid_for: Age- and UK-specific published survey and viewing measures within each stated study denominator
source_records.not_for: Cross-country minors or inferred age characteristics of identifiable viewers

source_records.valid_for: Vendor-indexed public subscriber and net-video-count snapshots with reported selection rules
source_records.not_for: Every YouTube channel, unique creators, actually uploaded videos, monetization approval or median profit

source_records.valid_for: What the voluntary EU27 creator respondents reported to the platform on particular questions
source_records.not_for: Representative EU creator opinion percentages, individual income, causality or all-Europe results
source_records.publisher: YouTube News and Events / Government Affairs EMEA

source_records.valid_for: The research question and findings described in the publicly accessible peer-reviewed article abstract
source_records.not_for: Unexamined full-text sampling detail, causal identification or a general creator income distribution

source_records.valid_for: One video producer's self-logged time for their 61 completed photography videos
source_records.not_for: Population-average video effort, earnings or unpublished production attempts
source_records.publisher: Zen Against The Machine (photography channel author's first-person blog)

source_records.valid_for: The closing of a specific corporate acquisition on the filing's transaction date
source_records.not_for: Creator program eligibility, current ownership terms or a numeric creator income trend

comparison_axes.required: originating organization and whether reporting its own platform/product
sampling frame, recruitment, inclusion/exclusions, nonresponse, weights and respondent unit where a population estimate is asserted
exact measured unit, country and observation period, including event versus person versus account
first-hand data generation versus sponsor-selected publication, replicated by another dataset only after actual cross-source matching
abstract-only, aggregate release, complete published method or verified underlying records
specific claim the document does and does not support, including policy snapshot versus income or causality

label_policy: Source tiers are purpose-specific and not a numerical global ranking; an official policy page is directly relevant for platform rules but not an independent user-population sample.
constraints: The eight cases are a selected crosswalk, not a full manual review of every source.
The source URL and metadata are recorded from the existing source register; original texts are not freshly independently reopened here.
A platform-sponsored consultation is not a representative study just because it reports thousands of respondents.
A peer-reviewed abstract is not independently audited underlying microdata.
A first-person diary is legitimate evidence for its author but not the median effort for all channels.
A regulatory or nationally sampled population survey may still omit subgroups and particular cell margins.
No source-quality label authorizes sensitive individual inference, scraping private data, or publication of raw participant records.
Undated rolling help pages are policy retrieval snapshots rather than established dates of original release.
